repos_data.description: MCP server for Redfin: search for-sale, for-rent and sold listings with the full filter set, and read one property page in full. No MLS licence. 1,000 free credits every month.
MCP server: find a US county's official parcel ArcGIS endpoint and search it by owner name or APN. No API key. npx -y @urbankitstudio/mcp-atlas

Hosted, pay-per-call MCP for Cook County / Chicago property records — dossier (parcels, sales & deeds, permits, tax assessments) + comparable-sales valuation by address or PIN. Returns joined/derived answers (permit→PIN links, comps) that raw open-data queries can't — not rows to stitch. Via x402.
